Name: Darcy's Coffee Shop (NPC)
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
[size=3]New NPC

[/size]Darcy is the owner of a coffee shop located in Pierre's shop. She has a passion for coffee and would love for you to try some of her pastries! She isn't dateable and doesn't attend festivals. She has a 6 and 8 heart event!

[size=3]New Shop

[/size]Darcy's cafe has coffee, hot chocolate, pastries, and recipes. She also has seasonal stock - a new drink for every season! Seasonal drinks give a +1 bonus to speed when consumed within their season. 

[size=3]New Drinks

[/size]Darcy's coffee shop has twelve new drinks and five new pastries. She also has seven seasonal drinks! She also may have a secret coffee recipe that she'd be willing to share if you're her friend...

Darcy also has drinks based around the festivals that are unlocked at a certain point!
[spoiler]To unlock festival drinks, watch Darcy's 8 heart event and then wait for her to send you a letter.[/spoiler]

[size=3]Portrait Mods[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39834?tab=description]Nyapu-style portraits [/url]﻿by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Blossom5280?gameId=1303]Blossom 5280[/url] (thanks so much!)

[size=3]Compatibility
[/size]Darcy can be moved into Leela's shop if you have her installed by editing the config
Compatible with SVE and A Pelican Town
May be incompatible with other mods that edit the interior of Pierre's coffee shop. If there is any conflict, try changing the config to move Darcy's Coffee Shop.
[b]Stardew Kids Expanded:[/b] Change the config location to "Location2" and it will be compatible.
